channel.title: West Seattle Dispatch
channel.description: West Seattle news, once a week, from the West Seattle Dispatch.

item.title: Alki gets the first Christmas Ship bonfire of the season, Friday, November 27, at 6 PM
item.description: Seattle Parks lights a free bonfire at Alki Beach, 2701 Alki Avenue SW, for the ship's stop.

item.title: Highland Park Way SW and SW Roxbury Street are getting grippier pavement from a $9.7 million federal grant
item.description: SDOT announced the award on November 2.

item.title: The Fauntleroy ferry dock gets a traffic signal before its rebuild
item.description: Washington State Ferries, with SDOT, plans to start work this fall on a signal where the terminal meets Fauntleroy Way SW, timed to balance neighborhood traffic, buses and ferry lines.

item.title: the drain on your corner
item.description: Leaves are the first thing that clogs a storm drain, and a clogged drain is how a rainy night turns into water across the street or in a basement.

item.title: Why SW Admiral Way, the climb from the West Seattle Bridge, is still posted at 25 mph, and whether it could go back up
item.description: A reader asked why SW Admiral Way, the climb from the West Seattle Bridge, is still posted at 25 mph, and whether it could go back up.
